BiblicalUsage: Pekahiah son of Menahem reigned two years over Israel in Samaria, in the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah. He followed his father's ways, and his captain Pekah conspired against him and killed him.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that a two-year reign is its own sermon: Pekahiah kept his father's sins and met his father's end, and the chronicler's verdict is short.
RelatedPeople: Pekahiah, King of Israel; Menahem, King of Israel
